result: Captured the approved first three Q-14 colour treatments in the real game: as it looks today, quiet world, and cold light. The pinned game revision was b30722a; Godot 4.7.2 rendered day 3 at 9:30 AM on seed 12345 with the player, well, mixed crops, fence and open boundary in the same full 800×600 frame. The labelled sheet is attached to Q-14 at hq/data/looks/world_colour_station/sheet.png; the three original frame PNGs and measurement/provenance README are beside it. The rig had shown 7:24 AM and cropped the station, so I corrected its energy and full-frame settings before the final capture. The changes in the field cover 99.68% of pixels for each grade; these are game-rendered colour studies, not image-editor recolours. Quiet/cold still grade the entire world rather than selectively preserving touchable saturation or adding cold machine accents. The higher-detail sheet was approved for generation on 2026-09-04 but is not yet present or swappable into the rig. Q-14 and the four-look pick remain open. Focused checks: 2946 unit and 999 integration assertions passed, 0 failed; writing verification found no new finding. No checker or Daniel approval is claimed.
